parts.text: SECOND VOICE An evening garden can be incredibly pleasant because it offers a peaceful atmosphere where the day's heat fades and gentle breezes arise. Soft twilight colors create a soothing backdrop, while the subtle scent of flowers becomes more pronounced in the cool air. The quiet sounds of nature, such as chirping insects and rustling leaves, enhance relaxation. This serene environment invites reflection and calm, making the garden a perfect retreat as day turns to night. GARDEN END
